Incoterms 2020

دولة العلم

The country in which a vessel is registered and whose laws, regulations, and international obligations the vessel must comply with, especially regarding safety and environmental standards.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is دولة العلم?

In this glossary, دولة العلم refers to: The country in which a vessel is registered and whose laws, regulations, and international obligations the vessel must comply with, especially regarding safety and environmental standards.

How is دولة العلم used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "دولة العلم للسفينة مسؤولة عن ضمان الامتثال لاتفاقيات السلامة البحرية ومنع التلوث الدولية."

Why does دولة العلم matter in logistics?

دولة العلم matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses دولة العلم?

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

The country in which a vessel is registered and whose laws, regulations, and international obligations the vessel must comply with, especially regarding safety and environmental standards.

Operational example

The vessel’s flag state is responsible for ensuring compliance with international maritime safety and pollution prevention conventions.

Localized term
